task.text: Which 12 human genes are both (a) druggable drug targets and (b) linked to at least two separate hallmarks of aging? Output format: one official HGNC gene symbol per line. Output nothing except the symbols.

outputs.text: Which 12 human genes are both (a) druggable drug targets and (b) linked to at least two separate hallmarks of aging? Output format: one official HGNC gene symbol per line. Output nothing except the symbols.
